shared_elements: small figure with limbs shown beside a larger element
justification: Both surfaces depict animal life rendered in a simplified way, and both include an isolated small disc/knob and undulating linear elements, but these are generic correspondences: A shows a dense stacked composition of quadrupeds, birds in a row and a hatched horizontal band arranged in registers, while B shows a single large horizontally undulating serpent beside one stick-like figure with raised arms. The manner of depiction also differs — A uses volumetric relief bodies with modelled heads and legs, B uses a bare continuous line silhouette — and no specific motif-plus-relationship is shared.
